title: SkillLevelSettings
description: Skill levels per inhabitant (B5 part, TL #19589): every inhabitant has, per skill of the register, a start level (from the register's range) and a talent, both drawn once from the world seed; practice (skills/practice.json) adds gain x talent when an action finishes, up to max_level; unpractised gains fade by forget_per_day. Values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

talent_min.description: Smallest talent: practice gain is multiplied by it.

forget_per_day.description: Practised level lost per game day (never below the start level).

max_level.description: Highest level a skill can reach.
